tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and app background. The anvil black (#1C1C1C) in the dark theme, white in the light theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Secondary areas on top of `bg`: sidebar, table headers, panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and dialogs. Always with a `line` border: we separate with lines, not shadows.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Background of code blocks, read-only fields and terminal areas.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a list row or a ghost button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Rules, dividers, card outlines. Decorative: never carries information on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of fields, checkboxes and secondary buttons (≥ 3:1 on `bg` and `surface` in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text, headings, icons, and the brand's single accent color (the anvil's white or black). On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, field hints, placeholder. ≥ 4.5:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled elements and line numbers only. Never for text meant to be read (< 4.5:1).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Solid background of strong elements: primary button, active selection, Production badge. The anvil in negative.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `inverse`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, offset by 2px. ≥ 14:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state (live deployment, passing test). Always with a word or an icon. Text on `bg`, `surface` and `success-subtle`.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning (build in progress, quota nearly reached). Always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure and destructive actions (failed build, revoke access, delete). Always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and banners.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing page title, once per page.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen title in the app (tool name).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Title of a panel or an important card.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Title of a card, block or dialog.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: This tool exposes 12 actions via MCP, API and Web.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, names in a list, emphasis.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, field hints, dense table cells.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, CLI commands, SDK snippets.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Identifiers in text: action names, versions, commit hashes, MCP URLs.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a heading. Once per block.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon–text gap, vertical padding of badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between items on the same row, horizontal padding of badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons and fields, table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of compact cards, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of cards and dialogs, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins, radius of the anvil pattern cutouts.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Breathing room between large marketing sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: All elements: cards, code blocks, menus, dialogs, buttons, fields, badges, checkboxes, banners. Forgeron rounds no corners, like the anvil.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots only (the dot before Production, Live). The only exception to sharp corners.

shadow.note: Forgeron separates with lines, not shadows. A single shadow, reserved for what floats above the content.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, command palette, dialogs. Always with a `line` border.
